reviews.x: Update:  Day 7: I've been tobacco free for 7 days now, something I NEVER thought I could do.  When buying beaver chew I was hoping to just cut down on chewing, but it worked so good I decided to go cold turkey.  The withdrawal process was a nightmare, worst experience I've ever had.  It amazes me that something so cruelly addictive is legal.  This chew definitely is not Copenhagen, but it will help get the monkey off your back.  After day 3 the urge for tobacco gets easier and easier to handle.

reviews.t: Use this stuff to quit dipping today.
reviews.x: 30 year dipper of snuff and really loved it but really wanted to quit.  I dipped mint flavored snuff and was able to transition off with this stuff.  Started mixing 50% snuff and 50% beaver and after each can, cut it a little bit more until there was only the beaver mint.  This a just walked away from it since I was completely off the nicotine.  Highly recommended.
Three out of the last 12 cans I’ve received have had cracked containers.  I will no longer order this product.

claims.text: Many reviewers say it helped them quit or cut back on tobacco, with several reporting being tobacco-free for weeks or months.
Some reviewers find the texture too sticky, gritty, or fine-cut compared to real chew, and a few say it dissolves poorly.
Reviewers praise the flavor and mouth feel, calling it a good or the best tobacco alternative they've tried.
A few reviewers were disappointed that it doesn't replicate the sensation or effect of real tobacco.
Some reviewers note packaging problems, with cracked plastic cans reported.
